title: MarineTraffic Favorite Vessel Arrival Slip
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marinetraffic:vessel
| stats avg(eta_slip_hr) as avg_eta_slip_hr, max(eta_slip_hr) as max_eta_slip_hr by vessel_name
| where avg_eta_slip_hr>2 OR max_eta_slip_hr>6
| sort - avg_eta_slip_hr
description: Uses MarineTraffic vessel feeds telemetry to monitor ETA slip on favorite ferries or tracked vessels in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for routes that are becoming less predictable, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest MarineTraffic vessel feeds data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Vessel table of average and max ETA slip.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces ETA slip on favorite ferries or tracked vessels so you can spot routes that are becoming less predictable before it becomes annoying.
